access_key.description:
The access key for API operations. You can retrieve this
from the 'Security & Credentials' section of the AWS console.

region.description:
The region where AWS operations will take place. Examples
are us-east-1, us-west-2, etc.

secret_key.description:
The secret key for API operations. You can retrieve this
from the 'Security & Credentials' section of the AWS console.

shared_config_files.description: List of paths to shared config files. If not set, defaults to [~/.aws/config].

target.description: The target to start the remote tunnel, such as an instance ID

token.description:
session token. A session token is only required if you are
using temporary security credentials.

local_host.description: The DNS name or IP address of the local host

local_port.description: The local port number to use for the tunnel

refresh_id.description: Any value as this will trigger a refresh

remote_host.description: The DNS name or IP address of the remote host

remote_port.description: The port number of the remote host

block.description: AWSM SSM Remote Tunnel data source
Data source used to keep the provider and tunnels alive
